description: Implementation of the DU Manager component for a 5G network, handling procedures such as setup, stop, configuration, and UE management within a DU (Distributed Unit).

classes.name: du_manager_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing DU operations, procedures, and UE interactions in a 5G network.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the DU manager, establishing necessary procedures and synchronization.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the DU manager, ensuring all procedures are completed and resources released.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_indication
methods.description: Processes UL-CCCH messages for UE creation requests.

methods.name: handle_crnti_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles C-RNTI CE indications for UE access success processing.

methods.name: handle_f1c_connection_loss
methods.description: Handles loss of F1-C connection, initiating disconnection procedures.

methods.name: handle_du_stop_request
methods.description: Handles requests to stop the DU, executing stop procedures.

methods.name: find_unused_du_ue_index
methods.description: Finds an unused UE index for new UE registration.

methods.name: handle_f1_reset_request
methods.description: Handles F1 reset requests for specified UEs.

methods.name: handle_cu_context_update_request
methods.description: Processes CU context update requests.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_creation
methods.description: Handles UE context creation requests.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_update
methods.description: Handles UE configuration update requests.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Handles UE deletion requests.

methods.name: handle_ue_drb_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles deactivation of UE data radio bearers.

methods.name: handle_reestablishment
methods.description: Processes UE reestablishment requests.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Marks UE configuration as applied.

methods.name: nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of active UEs in the DU.

methods.name: get_subframe_time_mapper
methods.description: Provides access to the subframe time mapper.

methods.name: configure_ue_mac_scheduler
methods.description: Configures the MAC scheduler for a UE.

methods.name: handle_operator_config
methods.description: Handles operator configuration requests asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_sync_operator_config
methods.description: Synchronously handles operator configuration requests.

methods.name: handle_ntn_param_update
methods.description: Processes NTN parameter update requests.
